2607.14553.title: Towards an Intention Abstraction Layer for Autonomous Industrial Systems
2607.14553.paper_summary: Modern industrial environments increasingly run many autonomous subsystems at once - schedulers, energy managers, vehicle fleets - each pursuing its own goals while sharing the same physical resources. Because high-level human intentions are translated into low-level control logic and then discarded, no running component can tell whether it is still doing what was actually intended, and goal conflicts surface only after they have caused a missed target or a shutdown. We propose the Intention Abstraction Layer (IAL), a domainagnostic middleware that represents intentions as first-class, persistent, and explainable runtime objects: a large language model grounded in a formal OWL ontology parses naturallanguage goals into structured intentions, a consistency monitor detects conflicts at registration time, before execution, and a transparency module explains them in natural language. We report a first proof of concept in which two autonomous agents register conflicting production and energy intentions, and the IAL flags and explains the conflict before it reaches the execution layer. The result is a mechanism that shifts behavioral assurance for cooperating autonomous systems from post-hoc failure analysis to pre-execution, intention-level checking.
2607.14553.paper_summary_zh: 現代工業環境中，越來越多的自主子系統同時運行——調度器、能源管理器、車隊——每個子系統都在追求自己的目標，同時共享相同的物理資源。由於高層次的人類意圖被轉化為低層次的控制邏輯後被丟棄，沒有任何運行中的組件能夠告訴自己是否仍在執行實際上所意圖的操作，而目標衝突通常在造成錯過目標或關閉後才顯現出來。我們提出了意圖抽象層（IAL），這是一種與領域無關的中介軟體，將意圖表示為一級、持久且可解釋的運行時對象：一個基於正式OWL本體的大型語言模型將自然語言目標解析為結構化的意圖，一個一致性監控器在註冊時檢測衝突，執行前進行檢查，而透明度模塊則用自然語言解釋這些衝突。我們報告了一個初步的概念驗證，其中兩個自主代理註冊了相互衝突的生產和能源意圖，而IAL在衝突到達執行層之前標記並解釋了該衝突。其結果是一種機制，將合作自主系統的行為保證從事後失敗分析轉移到執行前的意圖層級檢查。
